posts.title: Green Is Not Evidence: How I Keep AI-Written Code Honest
posts.excerpt: AI agents write most of the code in the ERP I am building. Type safety and lint rules catch the typos. What they do not catch is a false claim. Here is the harness I built for that.

posts.title: Swapping the Engine Mid-Flight: Shiranami 2 and a 186k-Line Merge
posts.excerpt: I rewrote the backend of my music player from Electron to Rust and Tauri on one long-lived branch, then merged 390 commits into master without users losing a single track. Here is the plan, the guardrails, and the Windows bugs no test caught.

posts.title: Taming 12 Terminals: How I Stopped the UI from Freezing
posts.excerpt: Running 12 AI coding sessions at once means 12 terminals generating output simultaneously. Here is how I kept the UI responsive.

posts.title: Building an Activity Feed Without Opening a Single Port
posts.excerpt: How I built a "currently watching" feed for my Discord community — and why I ditched the HTTP endpoint in favor of something already running.

posts.title: I Put a Browser Inside Electron (and Rewrote It Twice)
posts.excerpt: The story of building an embedded browser for an anime tracking app — from native overlays to DOM elements, z-index nightmares, and why the "deprecated" approach won.

posts.title: From if-statements to Plugins in 17 Days
posts.excerpt: How I extracted a hardcoded AI provider into a plugin architecture with 57 documented decisions, and why I chose bundled plugins over a marketplace.

posts.title: 7 Pitfalls I Predicted (and All 7 Happened)

posts.title: The AI Reports Its Own State: MCP as a Feedback Loop
